rundown: Blue Devils beat Bobcats 72-67 at Detrick Gymnasium in New Britain, CT in front of 1,713. Blue Devils came back: they were down 39-33 at half-time. Their win chance dropped as low as 11% along the way.
Leading the way — Bobcats: Keith McKnight 20 pts, 11 reb; Lucas Sekasi 4 ast. Blue Devils: Raphel Laurent 27 pts; Daniel James 3 ast; Victor Payne Jr. 5 reb.
Where Blue Devils won it: they shot 39% from three to 35%, had 12 assists to 11 and turned it over 9 times to 15.

Against the closing line (DraftKings): Bobcats closed as 3.5-point favorites and lost outright to Blue Devils; Blue Devils won as the underdog at +142; the total closed at 135.5 and they combined for 139, over by 3.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 15, 11:58 AM ET. It had Bobcats 48% and Blue Devils 52%, projecting Bobcats 76.3 – Blue Devils 76.9 (153.1 total, Blue Devils by 0.6).

Final: Bobcats 67 – Blue Devils 72. Right winner: it had Blue Devils at 52%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bobcats came in with a 4% below average attack and a league-average defense (2-2, 68.5 scored and 75.5 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 178 and 177 games of evidence. Projected to score 76.3, they scored 67 (−9.3 points, 12% under); projected to allow 76.9, they allowed 72 (−4.9 points, 6% under).

Blue Devils came in with a 6% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (2-2, 65.5 scored and 79 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 177 and 179 games of evidence. Projected to score 76.9, they scored 72 (−4.9 points, 6% under); projected to allow 76.3, they allowed 67 (−9.3 points, 12% under).

The bigger miss was Bobcats' scoring (-9.3 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 139 against 153.1 projected (-14.1), about the 16th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Blue Devils by 5 against Blue Devils by 0.6 projected, about the 65th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Blue Devils ×1.02, Bobcats ×1.00. It favored Blue Devils, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

QUIN ML (-170) at -170: the algo gave it 60% vs 60% fair (-0.7 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 60%). OVER 136.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 52% vs 49% fair (+3 pts), THE PICK — won (+1u); lost to the closing 135.5 by 1. UNDER 136.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 48% vs 51% fair (-3 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing 135.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: total 136.5 → 135.5. The total moved away from the algo's number.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 55% of bets on Bobcats, 70% of the money — Blue Devils covered; total: 78% of bets on the over, 83% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 86% of bets on Bobcats, 31% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Blue Devils, who won and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.894 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +5.5 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 564 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.984 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Bobcats attack ×0.993, defense ×0.979 (4 games); Blue Devils attack ×1.001, defense ×0.996 (4 games).

review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, the pick won (+1u).
